title.narrative: TRANSPerú – Sustainable Urban Transport NAMA Peru

description.narrative: The project was developed to halt the trend towards urban sprawl, dominated by cars, through high-quality public transport/vehicle fleet optimisation. This required: policy framework, additional infrastructure, and institutional set-up. A policy matrix integrated the transformation agenda: integrated mass public transit system in the metropolitan area of Lima; non-motorised transport; institutional set-up for urban transport management; mitigation of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions and pollutants from motor vehicles; modernisation of the public transport motor vehicle fleet; support to authorities on sustainable urban transport. The project created the basis for structural change. Financial and technical support were closely linked: steering committee coordination; mitigation: implementation of selected aspects in the policy matrix at (sub-)national level; measurement, reporting, and verification system.
